title: 第18章 铁匠铺里的新学徒第19章 打铁的生涯
slug: 百世轮回词条无限累加
lines: 白烟散去。
水桶里的水还在咕嘟咕嘟冒泡。
老巴克那一对眉头紧皱，看着自家闺女那副护犊子的模样，只觉得脑仁疼。
这丫头，胳膊肘往外拐得也太快了。
这才一晚上。
要是再过两晚上，是不是连家里的房契都能给这小子偷出来？
老巴克把手在围裙上擦了擦，那满手的黑灰倒是擦干净了，但心里的火气没下去。
他指着苏璃，嘴唇动了动，想骂两句脏话，可看着那张脸，脏话到了嘴边又咽了下去。
这小子长得太干净。
骂他都觉得自己是个罪人。
“玛莎！”
老巴克转头冲着屋里吼了一嗓子，声音震得房檐上的土都往下掉。
“死哪去了！赶紧出来！你闺女要把家搬空了！”
这家里大事小情，还得是婆娘拿主意。
他老巴克就是个抡大锤的，脑子不转弯。
屋里传来一阵拖鞋踢踏的声音。
紧接着，一个胖乎乎的妇人走了出来。
系着碎花围裙，手里还拿着把大木勺，看样子正在熬粥。
这就是铁匠铺真正的掌柜，玛莎婶子。
“嚎什么嚎？狼叼你了？”
玛莎婶子先是给了老巴克一个白眼，然后目光一转，落在了院子中间。
这一看，手里的木勺差点掉地上。
早晨的阳光正好打在苏璃身上。
虽然穿着皱巴巴的亚麻衣服，虽然头发乱得像个鸟窝。
但那个人站在那儿，就跟周围这堆破铜烂铁格格不入。
就像是一块精金掉进了煤渣堆里。
玛莎婶子这辈子去过最远的地方就是隔壁镇的集市，见过最大的人物就是在那儿收税的税务官。
但那个税务官跟眼前这个年轻人比起来，简直就是个土鳖。
这鼻子，这眼。
这身段。
玛莎婶子吸了吸气，又把那个不争气的老公往旁边挤了挤。
“这……这是谁？”
她的声音比刚才温柔了八度，听得老巴克起了一身鸡皮疙瘩。
塞娜赶紧跑过去，抱着她娘的胳膊撒娇。
“娘，这就是我昨晚跟你说的那个……那个路过的人。”
“他叫苏璃。”
“他在马厩睡了一宿，没地儿去，还没吃饭呢。”
塞娜一边说一边给苏璃使眼色。
苏璃心里好笑。
这姑娘倒是实诚，把自己那点底细全抖搂出来了。
他上前一步，手放在胸前。
“夫人好。”
“给您添麻烦了。”
这一声“夫人”，叫得玛莎婶子心花怒放。
content_en:
The white smoke disperses.
The water in the bucket was still bubbling.
Old Buck's brows were furrowed, and his head hurt when he looked at his daughter's protective look.
This girl's elbows turned out too fast.
It's only been one night.
If only two nights had passed, could this kid even have stolen the deed to the house?
Old Buck wiped his hands on his apron. The black dust on his hands was wiped clean, but the anger in his heart was gone.
He pointed at Su Li and moved his lips, wanting to curse a few curse words, but looking at that face, he swallowed the curse words as they reached his lips.
This guy looks too clean.
Even scolding him makes him feel like a sinner.
"Martha!"
Old Buck turned his head and roared into the house. The sound made the soil on the eaves fall down.
"Where are you dead! Come out quickly! Your daughter is going to evacuate the house!"
In this family, the mother-in-law has to make the final decision on all matters big and small.
His old Buck is just a sledgehammer and has no brains.
There was a sound of slippers tapping in the room.
Immediately afterwards, a chubby woman came out.
Wearing a floral apron and holding a large wooden spoon in his hand, he looked like he was making porridge.
This is the real owner of the blacksmith shop, Aunt Martha.
"What are you howling for? Did the wolf grab you?"
Aunt Martha first gave Old Buck a roll of her eyes, then turned her gaze and landed in the middle of the yard.
At this sight, the wooden spoon in his hand almost fell to the ground.
The morning sunshine happened to hit Su Li.
Even though he was wearing wrinkled linen clothes, even though his hair was as messy as a bird's nest.
But that man stood there, incompatible with the pile of junk and iron around him.
It was like a piece of gold dropped into a cinder heap.
The farthest place Aunt Martha had ever been to was the market in the next town over, and the biggest person she had ever seen was the tax collector who collected taxes there.
But compared to the young man in front of me, that tax official was just a country bumpkin.
This nose, these eyes.
This figure.
Aunt Martha took a breath and pushed her unlucky husband to the side.
"Who...who is this?"
Her voice was an octave gentler than before, and Old Buck got goosebumps when she heard it.
Sena quickly ran over, hugged her mother's arm and acted coquettishly.
"Mom, this is the person I told you about last night...the person who passed by."
"His name is Su Li."
"He slept in the stable all night. He had nowhere to go and he hadn't eaten yet."
Sena said while winking at Su Li.
Su Li felt funny in her heart.
This girl was honest and revealed all the details about herself.
He took a step forward and put his hand on his chest.
"Hello, madam."
"I'm causing you trouble."
The word "ma'am" made Aunt Martha very happy.
